	# --- grain (base 20) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:grain.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:grain.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 35.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 5.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_grain value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_grain value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_grain value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_grain value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- fish (base 20) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:fish.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:fish.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 35.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 5.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_fish value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_fish value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_fish value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_fish value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- fabric (base 20) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:fabric.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:fabric.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }

		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}

		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 35.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 5.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_fabric value = local_var:stl_p }

			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 105.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 15.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- luxury_furniture (base 60) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 60 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 60 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 105.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 15.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- automobiles (base 100) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:automobiles.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:automobiles.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 100 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 100 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 175.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 25.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_automobiles value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_automobiles value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_automobiles value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_automobiles value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- telephones (base 70) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:telephones.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:telephones.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 70 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 70 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 122.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 17.5 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_telephones value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_telephones value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_telephones value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_telephones value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- radios (base 80) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:radios.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:radios.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 80 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 80 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 140.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_radios value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_radios value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_radios value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_radios value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- fine_art (base 200) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:fine_art.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:fine_art.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 200 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 200 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 350.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 50.0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_price_fine_art value = local_var:stl_p }
		set_variable = { name = stl_econ_fine_art value = local_var:stl_e }
		set_variable = { name = stl_minbs_fine_art value = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = stl_prod_fine_art value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
}

# Accumulate WAS/WAD and market-price sums for all goods from one
# partner state. Scope: partner state. Requires:
#   scope:stl_gravity_self = origin state
#   local_var:stl_pw       = proximity weight (100 - friction)
stl_phase_b_accumulate_all_goods = {
	# --- grain ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_grain }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_grain }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_grain }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_grain multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_grain add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_grain add = var:stl_prod_grain }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_grain } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_grain }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_grain } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_grain add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_grain add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_grain add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_grain add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fish ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_fish }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_fish }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_fish }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_fish multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fish add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fish add = var:stl_prod_fish }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_fish } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_fish }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_fish } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fish add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fish add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fish add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_fish add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fabric ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_fabric }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_fabric }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_fabric }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_fabric multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fabric add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fabric add = var:stl_prod_fabric }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_fabric } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_fabric }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_fabric } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fabric add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fabric add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fabric add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_fabric add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- wood ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_wood }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_wood }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_wood }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_wood multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_wood add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_wood add = var:stl_prod_wood }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_wood } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_wood }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_wood } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_wood add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_wood add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_wood add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_wood add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- groceries ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_groceries }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_groceries }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_groceries }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_groceries multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_groceries add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_groceries add = var:stl_prod_groceries }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_groceries } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_groceries }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_groceries } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_groceries add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_groceries add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_groceries add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_groceries add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- clothes ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_clothes }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_clothes }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_clothes }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_clothes multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_clothes add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_clothes add = var:stl_prod_clothes }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price

			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }

			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_tobacco add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }

	}
	# --- telephones ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_telephones }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_telephones }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_telephones }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_telephones multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_telephones add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_telephones add = var:stl_prod_telephones }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 70 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_telephones } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_telephones }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_telephones } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_telephones add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_telephones add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_telephones add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_telephones add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- radios ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_radios }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_radios }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_radios }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_radios multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_radios add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_radios add = var:stl_prod_radios }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 80 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_radios } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_radios }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_radios } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_radios add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_radios add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_radios add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_radios add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fine_art ---
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_econ_fine_art }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = var:stl_price_fine_art }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_fine_art }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_fine_art multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fine_art add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fine_art add = var:stl_prod_fine_art }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 200 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { has_variable = stl_market_price_fine_art } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.var:stl_market_price_fine_art }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = var:stl_econ_fine_art } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fine_art add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fine_art add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fine_art add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_fine_art add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Finalize one origin: fold own state into the market price, compute
# the direction-aware export/import targets, persist gravity scores.
# Scope: origin state (after the partner loop).
stl_phase_b_finalize_prices = {
	# --- grain ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_grain has_variable = stl_price_grain }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_grain multiply = var:stl_price_grain } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_grain add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_grain add = var:stl_prod_grain }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_grain > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_grain divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_grain } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_grain value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_grain value = local_var:stl_acc_was_grain }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_grain value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_grain }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_grain value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_grain }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_grain value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_grain }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_grain add = local_var:stl_acc_was_grain } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_grain
			has_variable = stl_econ_grain
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_grain subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_grain divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_grain }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_grain multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_grain value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_grain } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_grain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_grain value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_grain } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_grain }
	}
	# --- fish ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_fish has_variable = stl_price_fish }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_fish multiply = var:stl_price_fish } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fish add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fish add = var:stl_prod_fish }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fish > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fish divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fish } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fish value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_fish value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fish }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_fish value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fish }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_fish value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fish }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_fish value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fish }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fish add = local_var:stl_acc_was_fish } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_fish
			has_variable = stl_econ_fish
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fish subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_fish divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_fish }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_fish multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fish value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_fish } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_fish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fish value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_fish } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_fish }
	}
	# --- fabric ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_fabric has_variable = stl_price_fabric }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_fabric multiply = var:stl_price_fabric } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fabric add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fabric add = var:stl_prod_fabric }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fabric > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fabric divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fabric } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fabric value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_fabric value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fabric }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_fabric value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fabric }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_fabric value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fabric }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_fabric value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fabric }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fabric add = local_var:stl_acc_was_fabric } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_fabric
			has_variable = stl_econ_fabric
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fabric subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_fabric divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_fabric }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_fabric multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fabric value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_fabric } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_fabric }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fabric value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_fabric } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_fabric }
	}
	# --- wood ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_wood has_variable = stl_price_wood }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_wood multiply = var:stl_price_wood } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_wood add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_wood add = var:stl_prod_wood }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_wood > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_wood divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_wood } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_wood value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_wood value = local_var:stl_acc_was_wood }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_wood value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_wood }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_wood value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_wood }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_wood value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_wood }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_wood add = local_var:stl_acc_was_wood } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_wood
			has_variable = stl_econ_wood
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_wood subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_wood divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_wood }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_wood multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_wood value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_wood } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_wood }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_wood value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_wood } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_wood }
	}
	# --- groceries ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_groceries has_variable = stl_price_groceries }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_groceries multiply = var:stl_price_groceries } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_groceries add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_groceries add = var:stl_prod_groceries }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_groceries > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_groceries divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_groceries } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_groceries value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_groceries value = local_var:stl_acc_was_groceries }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_groceries value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_groceries }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_groceries value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_groceries }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_groceries value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_groceries }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_groceries add = local_var:stl_acc_was_groceries } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_groceries
			has_variable = stl_econ_groceries
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_groceries subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_groceries divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_groceries }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_groceries multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_groceries value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_groceries } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_groceries }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_groceries value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_groceries } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_groceries }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_iron add = local_var:stl_acc_was_iron } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_iron
			has_variable = stl_econ_iron
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_iron subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_iron divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_iron }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_iron multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_iron value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_iron } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_iron }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_iron value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_iron } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_iron }
	}
	# --- lead ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_lead has_variable = stl_price_lead }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_lead multiply = var:stl_price_lead } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_lead add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_lead add = var:stl_prod_lead }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_lead > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_lead divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_lead } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_lead value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}

	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_lead value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_lead }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_lead value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_lead }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_lead value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_lead }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---

		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_silk value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {

		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_silk } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_silk }
	}

		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_silk value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }

	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.

		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_dye }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_dye multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }

		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tools value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_tools } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_tools }
	}
	# --- steel ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_steel has_variable = stl_price_steel }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_steel multiply = var:stl_price_steel } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_steel add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_steel add = var:stl_prod_steel }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steel > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_steel divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steel } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_steel value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI

	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_steel value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_steel }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_steel value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_steel }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_steel value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_steel }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_steel add = local_var:stl_acc_was_steel } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_steel
			has_variable = stl_econ_steel
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_steel subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_steel divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_steel }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_steel multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_steel value = local_var:stl_x }
	}

		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_steel } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_steel }

	if = {

		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_tanks multiply = var:stl_price_tanks } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_tanks add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_tanks add = var:stl_prod_tanks }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_tanks > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_tanks divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_tanks } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_tanks value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_tanks value = local_var:stl_acc_was_tanks }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_tanks value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_tanks }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_tanks value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_tanks }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_tanks value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_tanks }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_tanks add = local_var:stl_acc_was_tanks } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_tanks
			has_variable = stl_econ_tanks
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_tanks subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_tanks divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_tanks }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_tanks multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tanks value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_tanks } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_tanks }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tanks value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_tanks } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_tanks }
	}
	# --- aeroplanes ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_aeroplanes has_variable = stl_price_aeroplanes }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_aeroplanes multiply = var:stl_price_aeroplanes } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_aeroplanes add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_aeroplanes add = var:stl_prod_aeroplanes }

	}

	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_aeroplanes }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_aeroplanes }

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }

		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_aeroplanes

		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_liquor value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_liquor value = local_var:stl_acc_was_liquor }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_liquor value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_liquor }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_liquor value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_liquor }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_liquor value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_liquor }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_liquor add = local_var:stl_acc_was_liquor } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_liquor
			has_variable = stl_econ_liquor
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_liquor subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_liquor divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_liquor }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_liquor multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_liquor value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_liquor } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_liquor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_liquor value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_liquor } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_liquor }
	}
	# --- wine ---

		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_wine has_variable = stl_price_wine }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_wine multiply = var:stl_price_wine } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_wine add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_wine add = var:stl_prod_wine }
	}

	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_luxury_clothes }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_clothes add = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_clothes } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
			has_variable = stl_minbs_luxury_clothes
			has_variable = stl_econ_luxury_clothes
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_sig value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_clothes subtract = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_clothes divide = local_var:stl_tot } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = var:stl_minbs_luxury_clothes }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_econ_floor value = { value = var:stl_econ_luxury_clothes multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_econ_floor > local_var:stl_basis }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_basis value = local_var:stl_econ_floor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = { value = local_var:stl_sig multiply = 0.1333 multiply = local_var:stl_basis } }
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	# x > 0: raise price (depot buys / export side); x < 0: lower (sells / import side)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_x }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x > 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_luxury_clothes } remove_variable = stl_eff_export_luxury_clothes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_x_abs value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_x } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_x_abs }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_x < -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_luxury_clothes } remove_variable = stl_eff_import_luxury_clothes }
	}
	# --- luxury_furniture ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = stl_prod_luxury_furniture has_variable = stl_price_luxury_furniture }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = var:stl_prod_luxury_furniture multiply = var:stl_price_luxury_furniture } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_luxury_furniture add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture add = var:stl_prod_luxury_furniture }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_luxury_furniture divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	set_variable = { name = stl_was_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_was_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_luxury_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = stl_wad_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = stl_max_wad_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_luxury_furniture }
	# --- signal -> capped injection target (ARCHITECTURE_V3.md) ---
	# sig = (WAD - WAS) / (WAD + WAS); x = sig x INJ_K x basis
	# basis = min(buy, sell), floored at 10% of economy scale so
	# pure producers/consumers still receive a small nudge.
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tot value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_furniture add = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_furniture } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_x value = 0 }

			local_var:stl_tot > 0.01
